text:
Ange-Yoan Bonny partners Marcus Thuram in attack for Inter against Venezia, whilst Davide Nicola sticks with under-fire striker Akor Adams in his front line for the hosts.
It kicks off at 18:30 CET [17:30 GMT] at the Stadio Pier Luigi Penzo, with Luca Pairetto refereeing.
You can follow all the action live, as well as tonight’s other Serie A fixtures, here.
Inter need three points to draw level with Lazio again at the top of Serie A. Gennaro Gattuso’s side moved three points clear on 25 with their 6-2 win at Sassuolo last night. Cristian Chivu’s side came from behind to beat Fiorentina 2-1 on Sunday, with Marcus Thuram and Piotr Zieliński both scoring in stoppage time. Saturday’s derby against Milan is next.
Venezia are bottom with three points. They beat Napoli in Davide Nicola’s first game in charge, but lost 1-0 at Genoa on Sunday.
The game has a family subplot. Venezia goalkeeper Filip Stanković came through the Inter academy, and the Nerazzurri kept a 50% sell-on clause when they sold him in 2024. His younger brother Aleksandar is in the Inter squad, and their father Dejan won the Treble at the club.
Lautaro Martínez (hamstring) and Luis Henrique (adductor) are both out until after the international break. Benjamin Pavard (adductor), Curtis Jones (adductor) and John Stones (hamstring) are also missing. Pavard and Jones are hoping to be fit for next Tuesday’s Champions League game.
Venezia are without Thierry Correia (hamstring), Marin Šverko (hip), Andrea Adorante (back surgery) and Bartol Franjić (shoulder surgery).
Neither side has any players suspended.
Venezia vs. Inter – official line-ups
Venezia: F. Stankovic; Halhal, Moreno, Juan Jesus; Hainaut, Kike Perez, Sohm, Helgason, Mazzocchi; Lauberbach, Adams
Coach: Nicola
Inter: Provedel; Bisseck, Bastoni, Carlos Augusto; Diouf, Sucic, Stankovic, Zielinski, Dimarco; Bonny, Thuram
Coach: Chivu
digest_he: אינטר תפגוש את ונציה באצטדיון פייר לואיג'י פנצו במטרה להדביק את הפער בפסגת הסרייה א. המשחק כולל גם פיקנטיקה משפחתית כאשר שוער ונציה, פיליפ סטנקוביץ', יפגוש את קבוצתו לשעבר ואת אחיו הצעיר המשחק באינטר. אינטר מגיעה למשחק ללא מספר שחקני מפתח הפצועים, אך תקווה להשיג שלוש נקודות חשובות.
